title: Appeals and Grievances Casebook: Payment at Issue Where Another Insurer Paid on a Late-Filed TRICARE Select Line
content:
Casebook, Appeals and Grievances: the three methods for the payment at issue on the line opening a case

Scope: a Claim Factual Reconsideration opened on a TRICARE Select claim line that was denied because the claim reached the region after the claim filing deadline.

Rule: The payment at issue on the line opening a case is figured by one of three methods: where the other insurer's payment counted is at least the allowed amount at issue, no payment is at issue; where a payment by another insurer below the allowed amount at issue is counted, the cost share is figured on the allowed amount at issue less that payment and the payment at issue is that net amount less the cost share; in every other case the cost share is figured on the allowed amount at issue itself and the payment at issue is the allowed amount at issue less the cost share; each amount is rounded to the cent. The tier whose schedule figures apply is the tier of the TRICARE Select enrollment the line opening a case was billed under.

Hypothetical: allowed amount at issue 300.00, a 20 percent cost share.

- Counted 300.00: equal to the allowed amount, so no payment is at issue (0.00).
- Counted 350.00: above the allowed amount, so no payment is at issue (0.00).
- Counted 120.00: net 180.00; cost share 20 percent of 180.00 is 36.00; payment at issue 144.00.
- Nothing counted: cost share 20 percent of 300.00 is 60.00; payment at issue 240.00.

The cost share in each case is figured on the amount the method names — the allowed amount at issue less the payment counted, or the allowed amount at issue itself.
